scripts.build:tauri: cross-env VITE_TAURI=1 tsc -b && cross-env VITE_TAURI=1 vite build
scripts.bump-version:
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const v=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('version.json','utf8'));v.updates+=1;const tenths=Math.floor(v.updates/100);const major=1+Math.floor(tenths/10);const minor=tenths%10;v.version=major+'.'+minor+'.'+v.updates;fs.writeFileSync('version.json',JSON.stringify(v,null,2)+'
');fs.writeFileSync('src/version.ts','export const APP_VERSION = '+JSON.stringify(v.version)+'
export const UPDATE_COUNT = '+v.updates+'
export const APK_DOWNLOAD_URL = "https://github.com/facincanitech/thothchat/releases/download/latest/thothchat.apk"
export const DESKTOP_DOWNLOAD_URL = "https://github.com/facincanitech/thothchat/releases/download/latest/ThothChat-Messenger-Setup.exe"
');console.log('version',v.version,'updates',v.updates)"
scripts.deploy: npm run bump-version && npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('docs',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('dist','docs',{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync('docs/.nojekyll','');fs.copyFileSync('version.json','docs/version.json')"
